'''Xie Yuyuan''' ({{zh|s=谢毓元}}; April 19, 1924 – March 27, 2021) was a Chinese pharmaceutical chemist. He was an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="man">{{cite news |author1=Li Yuan ({{lang|zh|李苑}}) |date=March 27, 2021 |title= |script-title=zh:缅怀！谢毓元院士逝世 |trans-title=Farewell! Academician Xie Yuyuan is dead |url=https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_11919435 |access-date=April 3, 2021 |work=[[The Paper (newspaper)|The Paper]] |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Xie was born in [[Beijing]], on April 19, 1924, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] was in [[Suzhou]], [[Jiangsu]].<ref name="dalasi">{{cite news|url=https://news.bjd.com.cn/2021/03/28/64632t100.html |script-title=zh:中科院院士、著名药物化学家谢毓元逝世，享年97岁|trans-title=Xie Yuyuan, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and famous medicinal chemist, dies at the age of 97|work=bjd.com.cn |date=March 28, 2021 |access-date=April 3, 2021 |language=zh}}</ref> In his early years, he studied in the Department of Chemical Engineering of [[Soochow University (1900–1952)|Soochow University]]. In 1941, when the [[Imperial Japanese Army]] occupied the {{ill|Shanghai concession|zh|上海租界}}, his father ordered him to drop out of school and stay at home. After the [[Second Sino-Japanese War]] in 1945, he was admitted to the Department of Chemistry, [[Tsinghua University]]. After graduating in 1949, he taught at the university.<ref name="dalasi"/> In 1951, he was dispatched to the Shanghai institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences.<ref name="dalasi"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] in 1956.<ref name="dalasi"/> In 1957, he was sent abroad to study at [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] at the expense of the government. He returned to China in September 1993 and continued to work at the Shanghai institute of Organic Chemistry.<ref name="dalasi"/> On March 27, 2021, he died in [[Shanghai]], aged 96.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Yang Zhenying ({{lang|zh|杨珍莹}}) |date=March 28, 2021 |title= |script-title=zh:他曾研发首个被国外公司仿制的中国新药！谢毓元院士昨在沪逝世 |trans-title=Academician Xie Yuyuan dies in Shanghai yesterday |url=https://m.thepaper.cn/baijiahao_11931553 |access-date=April 3, 2021 |work=[[The Paper (newspaper)|The Paper]] |language=zh}}</ref>
